annotations.title: Get a Stripe checkout link for a paid plan

description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link for the Pro or Business plan on a confirmed account that has no paid subscription yet, for a user who chose a paid plan. An account that already pays changes its plan in Billing in the panel. Payment happens only on Stripe's page; the tool takes no card details.
name: start_checkout
title: Get a Stripe checkout link for a paid plan
